values.meaning: Bonus true damage to enemies hit within the outer edge
values.quote: Enemies hit within the outer edge of the area additionally take the same amount as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}

mechanics.claim: Prance stacks are generated whenever any Lillia ability hits at least one enemy, refresh on subsequent hits, and cap at 4 stacks; stacks expire one at a time after the duration ends.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Prance'' for {{fd|6.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|1.5}} seconds when the duration ends.

mechanics.claim: Lillia can move during the Q cast time, so casting it does not stop her movement.
mechanics.quote: '''Lillia''' can move during Blooming Blows' cast time.

mechanics.claim: Spell shields cannot block the Prance stack Lillia gains from casting Q.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent '''Lillia''' from gaining a ''Prance'' stack.

mechanics.claim: Enemies caught in the outer ring of the swing take both the magic damage and an equal amount of bonus true damage, i.e. up to double damage at the edge of the radius.
mechanics.quote: Enemies hit within the outer edge of the area additionally take the same amount as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}.
